title: Cu-doped In2S3 quantum dot-CeO2 nanorod hybrid electrodes via 3D nanoprinting-inspired structuring for ultrasensitive heavy metal detection
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,43683-43701
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA07443F, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
A. K. Kareem, I. B. Sapaev, Fadhil Faez Sead, Payal Vaja, Malatesh Akkur, Sanjeev Kumar, Pragyan Paramita Pattnaik, Zainab Jamal Hamoodah, Basim Mohammed Saadi, Sharmin Smaeilpour
3D-nanoprinted Cu:In2S3 QD-CeO2 nanorod electrodes enable simultaneous ultrasensitive detection of Pb2+, Cd2+, and Hg2+ (LODs 32–60 nM) in serum/urine with 95.5–99.0% recovery, via synergistic catalysis and enhanced surface accessibility.
